messages:
noah: Heads-up—I'm opening a tiny docs hotfix to add the incident link + a short mitigation for the token-refresh 401s. tagging reviewers.

noah: status link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-11-token-refresh
Proposed copy: "Temporary mitigation: If you experience intermittent 401s on long-lived streams after the incident, call the token refresh endpoint and then re-open your stream. See examples below for JS and curl. Engineering will deploy a permanent fix soon."

tara: 👍 keep it concise. per comms, avoid 'major outage' language and use 'incident' or 'service disruption' instead. add frontmatter `hotfixes: ["incident-2026-11-token-refresh"]`.

noah: adding snippets. JS minimal: `await client.auth.refreshToken()` then restart stream. curl for ops: 
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/refresh \
  -d '{"grant_type":"refresh_token","refresh_token":"REPLACE_ME"}'
```

eng-oncall: please also include a note for long-running batch jobs that may need periodic refreshes; one short sentence is fine.

noah: added one-liner for batch jobs. opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6222 — includes MD change + frontmatter + snippets. Preview: https://deploy-preview-6222--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh-mitigation

ci-bot: build started for PR #6222 - job: ci/docs-preview.

noah: quick QA pass: preview looks ok but JS fence missing language tag. pushing tiny fix.

ci-bot: build failed for PR #6222 - error: docs-linter/links: forbidden external internal-kb link present (`/internal/kb/token-refresh-runbook`).

tara: that's expected. we can't link internal KB from public docs. replace with "internal runbook available to support teams" and add KB link only in the cherry-pick to release branch (internal only).

noah: removed internal link and updated wording. pushed.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #6222 - preview: https://deploy-preview-6222--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh-mitigation

eng-oncall: quick read-through — nit: change 're-open your stream' to 'restart your stream' for clarity. otherwise good.

noah: updated wording to 'restart your stream' and pushed.

tara: approving now so support has it for morning shift. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: PR #6222 merged into main by noah (docs).

noah: will open a follow-up internal-only cherry-pick to `release/2026-11` that includes the internal KB link and the runbook snippet. @kb-bot can you create an internal KB entry once I ping you?

kb-bot: Created internal KB draft: /internal/kb/token-refresh-runbook (ID kb-2026-11-07). Runbook draft includes JS and curl snippets and steps to escalate to eng-oncall.

eng-oncall: thanks, will add a quick troubleshooting checklist.

statusbot: Incident 2026-11 token-refresh — mitigation documented. Postmortem link (when ready): https://status.redwood.example/postmortem/2026-11-token-refresh

noah: thanks everyone. closing loop here. if support reports new variants of the 401s we'll update the public doc and KB. :rocket:
